answer: A fee terrace that rises with every identity: the nth identity in one payout cluster pays n² × 20 POA at registration, enforced by the registry. One agent pays 20; a 100-puppet farm pays 338,350, not 2,000. Each fresh payout wallet must first finish three verified jobs before it can receive, so splitting the cluster only adds real work. Like an ember fed with each new fake, the cost compounds per identity, and no bulk discount exists: the farm faces a glacier of fees it cannot melt by splitting wallets.
